title: Anatomical Basis of Accommodation
description: How does the eye actually change focus from far to near? In this episode of Focus Cast by focuslinks, we assemble the machinery of accommodation from the parts already built this season: the elastic lens capsule, the zonular suspension, the ciliary muscle ring, and the vitreous boundary behind the lens. We walk through Helmholtz's hypothesis step by step, with real measurements of curvature, thickness and amplitude, and explain why the front surface of the lens does most of the work. A clear anatomical foundation for optometry students, clinicians, and anyone curious about how near vision happens.
